scope: Product UI mockup, existing Spatial/V2 control contract, approved Glass C / Day Lab presentation.

tokens.safe_area: top and bottom insets; validate in Unity Canvas on real devices

main_menu.play: resume current unlocked level; first run: introduction then level 1
main_menu.home: unlock after Boss 10; locked entry explains requirement
main_menu.intro: replay existing intro; exit or completion returns to Main Menu

contextual: body fragment selectors with mass shares and one selected-body arrow
gestures: tap surface or handle to guide
gameplay.configuration: respect per-level control exceptions and existing raycast/picking rules

pause.resume: resume simulation and input; preserve exact puzzle state
pause.pause_contract: stop physics, AI/gameplay timers and input; UI remains interactive
pause.help: generic controls only; no puzzle hints on Boss
pause.leave: confirm; preserve completed progression, current attempt restarts on return

success.campaign_end: campaign completion state; never load an absent next level

home_preview: Layout only. Feed/Play/Collection entry placement; furnishing/shop is outside this approval.
review_limitations: Scene and creature imagery are static crops of existing Unity screenshots, composed by CSS.
Controls demonstrate UI state only, not Unity physics, picking, saves or audio playback.
Success auto-next demo advances a mock level number over the same illustrative scene.
Font and wordmark treatment is proposed, not replacement of an official logo asset.
No device performance claim from browser layout checks.
implementation_after_approval: Remove product access to debug level selection while retaining internal developer tooling behind development configuration.
Use stable campaign save IDs; do not reset or renumber progress from UI.
Use localized string keys, English as default.
Use UI icon atlas and 9-slice panels; avoid fullscreen blur and additional realtime lights.
Separate static/dynamic Canvas changes; profile real OPPO interactions, text rebuilds and popup transitions.
Verify safe areas, pause timer behavior, independent saved audio toggles, fragment selection, end-of-campaign and Home unlock on device.

assets.asset_treatment: source rasters copied unchanged, framed with CSS; no Unity content changes
